GOV-SCOPE-001.heading: GOV-SCOPE-001 — Historical summary milestone boundary
GOV-SCOPE-001.claim: Milestone one is limited to grounded summarization of synthetic historical drilling data in Microsoft Fabric. It includes the data contract, deterministic generator, Fabric ingestion and transformation, governed semantic definitions, summary-question evaluation, citations, synthetic-data disclosure, and a curated activity receipt. Comparable-run retrieval, similarity scoring, and prediction are deferred to later milestones and must not be introduced into milestone-one scope.

GOV-SYNTHETIC-LIMITS-001.heading: GOV-SYNTHETIC-LIMITS-001 — Synthetic evidence limitations
GOV-SYNTHETIC-LIMITS-001.claim: Synthetic data may demonstrate workflow behavior, reproducibility, data-quality controls, and recovery of specified simulated relationships. It does not establish real-well predictive accuracy, operational recommendations, production readiness, safety, cost savings, or regulatory compliance.

GOV-FABRIC-001.heading: GOV-FABRIC-001 — Authorized Fabric verification boundary
GOV-FABRIC-001.claim:
Read-only verification queries, model refresh testing, and metadata validation are authorized.

Use only read access to the verified `serving` views for development and validation. This authorization does not permit mutation of published Lakehouse data or expansion to unverified sources.

This authorization does not permit a Fabric Data Agent, Foundry agents, custom UI, prediction, similarity, a validation workspace, real data, external sharing, new capacity, production-readiness or business-performance claims, or public release.

User identity and authorization must survive each service boundary without shared credentials, privilege expansion, or loss of row-level policy context.

Read-only verification queries, model refresh testing, and metadata validation are authorized. Drafting an objective summary-answer question set and proposed numerical evaluation thresholds is also authorized.
